mapper.sql: CASE WHEN P.QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'OUT' WHEN P.QUANTITY > P.THRESHOLD_VALUE THEN 'IN' ELSE 'LOW' END
mapper.select:
SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_CODE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY_CODE , P.BUYING_PRICE, P.QUANTITY, P.UNIT , TO_CHAR(P.EXPIRY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS EXPIRY_DATE , P.THRESHOLD_VALUE , AS AVAILABILITY , (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE C WHERE C.GROUP_CODE = 'AVAILABILITY' AND C.CODE = ) AS AVAILABILITY_NAME FROM PRODUCT P
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC LIMIT #{PAGE_SIZE} OFFSET #{OFFSET}

SELECT P.PRODUCT_CODE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY_CODE, P.BUYING_PRICE, P.QUANTITY, P.UNIT , TO_CHAR(P.EXPIRY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EXPIRY_DATE, P.THRESHOLD_VALUE , AS AVAILABILITY FROM PRODUCT P
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CATEGORY_CODE) FROM PRODUCT WHERE IS_DELETED = FALSE) AS CATEGORY_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE IS_DELETED = FALSE) AS PRODUCT_COUNT , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-M.QUANTITY * M.UNIT_PRICE), 0) FROM STOCK_MOVEMENT M WHERE M.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'SALE' AND M.MOVEMENT_DATE >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days') AS REVENUE , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT M.PRODUCT_ID) FROM STOCK_MOVEMENT M WHERE M.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'SALE' AND M.MOVEMENT_DATE >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days') AS TOP_SELLING , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-M.QUANTITY * P.BUYING_PRICE), 0) FROM STOCK_MOVEMENT M JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = M.PRODUCT_ID WHERE M.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'SALE' AND M.MOVEMENT_DATE >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days') AS TOP_SELLING_COST , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE IS_DELETED = FALSE AND QUANTITY > 0 AND QUANTITY <= THRESHOLD_VALUE) AS LOW_STOCK , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE IS_DELETED = FALSE AND QUANTITY = 0) AS OUT_OF_STOCK

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_CODE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY_CODE, C.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME , P.BUYING_PRICE, P.QUANTITY, P.UNIT , TO_CHAR(P.EXPIRY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS EXPIRY_DATE , P.THRESHOLD_VALUE, P.IMAGE_DATA , AS AVAILABILITY , (SELECT A.CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE A WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = 'AVAILABILITY' AND A.CODE = ) AS AVAILABILITY_NAME , TO_CHAR(P.CREATED_AT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CREATED_DATE , S.SUPPLIER_ID, S.SUPPLIER_NAME, S.CONTACT_NUMBER AS SUPPLIER_CONTACT , S.EMAIL AS SUPPLIER_EMAIL, S.RETURN_TYPE AS SUPPLIER_RETURN_TYPE , (SELECT R.CODE_NAME FROM COMMON_CODE R WHERE R.GROUP_CODE = 'RETURN_TYPE' AND R.CODE = S.RETURN_TYPE) AS SUPPLIER_RETURN_TYPE_NAME , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(M.QUANTITY), 0) FROM STOCK_MOVEMENT M WHERE M.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND M.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'PURCHASE') AS PURCHASED_QTY , (SELECT COALESCE(-SUM(M.QUANTITY), 0) FROM STOCK_MOVEMENT M WHERE M.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND M.MOVEMENT_TYPE = 'SALE') AS SOLD_QTY FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON C.GROUP_CODE = 'CATEGORY' AND C.CODE = P.CATEGORY_CODE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM SUPPLIER X WHERE X.IS_DELETED = FALSE AND LOWER(X.PRODUCT_NAME) = LOWER(P.PRODUCT_NAME) ORDER BY X.SUPPLIER_ID LIMIT 1) S ON TRUE WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = CAST(#{PRODUCT_ID} AS BIGINT) AND P.IS_DELETED = FALSE
SELECT S.LOCATION_NAME, S.QUANTITY FROM PRODUCT_STOCK S WHERE S.PRODUCT_ID = CAST(#{PRODUCT_ID} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY S.QUANTITY DESC, S.LOCATION_NAME

SELECT M.MOVEMENT_ID, M.MOVEMENT_TYPE, C.CODE_NAME AS MOVEMENT_TYPE_NAME , M.QUANTITY, M.UNIT_PRICE, M.NOTE , TO_CHAR(M.MOVEMENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS MOVEMENT_DATE , COALESCE(U.USER_NAME, 'System') AS USER_NAME FROM STOCK_MOVEMENT M LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON C.GROUP_CODE = 'MOVEMENT_TYPE' AND C.CODE = M.MOVEMENT_TYPE WHERE M.PRODUCT_ID = CAST(#{PRODUCT_ID} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY M.MOVEMENT_DATE DESC, M.MOVEMENT_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE LOWER(PRODUCT_CODE) = LOWER(#{PRODUCT_CODE})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, BUYING_PRICE, QUANTITY, UNIT, EXPIRY_DATE, THRESHOLD_VALUE, IMAGE_DATA) VALUES (#{PRODUCT_CODE}, #{PRODUCT_NAME}, #{CATEGORY_CODE}, CAST(#{BUYING_PRICE} AS NUMERIC), CAST(#{QUANTITY} AS INT), #{UNIT}, TO_DATE(#{EXPIRY_DATE}, 'YYYYMMDD'), CAST(#{THRESHOLD_VALUE} AS INT), NULLIF(CAST(#{IMAGE_DATA} AS TEXT), ''))
INSERT INTO PRODUCT_STOCK (PRODUCT_ID, LOCATION_NAME, QUANTITY) VALUES (CAST(#{PRODUCT_ID} AS BIGINT), #{LOCATION_NAME}, CAST(#{QUANTITY} AS INT))

INSERT INTO STOCK_MOVEMENT (PRODUCT_ID, MOVEMENT_TYPE, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, NOTE, USER_ID) VALUES (CAST(#{PRODUCT_ID} AS BIGINT), #{MOVEMENT_TYPE}, CAST(#{QUANTITY} AS INT), CAST(#{UNIT_PRICE} AS NUMERIC), #{NOTE}, CAST(NULLIF(CAST(#{USER_ID} AS VARCHAR), '') AS BIGINT))
